summary: Mask tool family - split Points / Detect / Shapes / Text into real sibling tools and extract the shared brush/eraser/invert/clear/opacity strip into ONE component. Two open questions for the user before implementation.

User answered all three open questions: one rail icon per tool inside the existing MASK group (no switcher), settings persist, and the shared strip must make the brush + eraser pair optional because the Points tool has no use for them. Design check recorded - Add bakes into manualCanvas and the brush is how that is cleaned up, so with no brush on Points cleanup means switching tools.
